user_story: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register using maximum allowed name length
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length.
Fill out all other required registration fields.
positive.expected_result: User registration is successful and the user is logged in or redirected to a welcome page.

negative.title: Register with a name exceeding maximum allowed length
steps: Enter a name exceeding the maximum allowed length.
Fill out all other required registration fields.
negative.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that the name exceeds the maximum allowed length.

edge.title: Register using a name of zero length
steps: Fill out all other required registration fields.
edge.expected_result: Registration fails with an error message indicating that the name is required.
